cohort: The study included 141 participants (mothers) within two weeks of their deliveries.
finding: No statistically significant differences were found in gender (of newborn), maternal age, delivery timing, mode of delivery, or post-delivery duration between mothers with EPDS scores indicative of PPD and those without.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery (LSCS vs. ND) did not show a statistically significant difference in EPDS scores between groups.
cross-section timing: within the first two weeks of delivery
